description: Validate, pretty-print (2 or 4 spaces, tab) or minify JSON, optionally sorting object keys (deeply). Invalid JSON gives a clear error with line and column and the lines around it. Also returns size, key count, depth and value count. Give "text" or a file "path"; "output" writes the result to a file. Uses the standard JSON parser (no comments or trailing commas). Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/json-studio/

mode.description: "format" pretty-prints, "minify" removes all whitespace, "validate" only checks (never throws on bad JSON).

output.description: Optional: also write the result to this file path (or folder ending in "/"). The result text is then left out of the reply. Results over 1,000,000 characters are always written to a file.

path.description: Or: a path to a JSON file (UTF-8; use this for big inputs).

sortKeys.description: Sort object keys alphabetically at every level.

name: json_format
title: JSON format / minify / validate
